Constraint description: Requests must be served by vehicles and volunteers belonging to the same organisation.
Each vehicle must complete a single trip starting and ending at its home depot.
Service times must account for travel time, service duration and waiting.
Each delivery must start within its specified time window.
The entire trip, from loading to return, must fall within every team member's shift.
Each assistant can be assigned to at most one vehicle.
The driver and assistants must not exceed the vehicle's seating capacity.
Ambient and chilled loads must not exceed their respective vehicle capacities.
At least one team member must be trained when serving a household requiring specialised assistance.
Reported metrics do not match the physical route, or output format was invalid.
